title: Recorder Trajectory Output
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $y$ be a Boolean word, let $T,W$ be natural numbers, and let $keep$ assign four Boolean words. Suppose every word in the layout consisting of the canonical recorder words followed by the four words assigned by $keep$ has length at most $W$. Let $x$ be the packed encoding of this layout. The recorder output machine computes the complete sequence of recorder rows through time $T$, namely the serialized record through horizon $T$, on input $x$ in exactly $2|x|+8+(k'+4)(3W+7)+(8F+7)(T+1)^2$ steps, where $k'$ is the number of work tapes of the recorder machine and $F$ is its recorder-field count.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Boolean Turing machine M
A function keep assigning four Boolean words
Every word in the specified layout has length at most W
replaced: For every source machine, virtual input $y$, horizon $T$, retained fields, and width bound $W$ covering all laid-out words, the trajectory-output machine computes, from the packed encoding of the layout, the complete serialized inclusive trajectory of rows $0,\dots,T$, within $2|x| + 8 + (k'+4)(3W+7) + (8F+7)(T+1)^2$ steps, where $x$ is the input, $k'$ the recorder tape count, and $F$ the field count; preparation, recording, rewind, replay, and the terminal transition are all charged.
